Code Description
A bicycle is a vehicle on the road or a pedestrian on
the sidewalk.
Only one person per bicycle seat.
Bicycles are not required to use a bike lane or shoulder.
Bicycles can and should use turn lanes.

Bicycles can ride on the left (with the traffic flow) on
one-way streets.
